item.title: ByteDance's TRAE Adds a Personal Developer Assistant With Cross-Project Memory and Chat-App Tasks
item.description: TRAE launched TRAE Bao, a developer assistant with a global layer that remembers work across projects and a project layer that runs tasks in parallel. Tasks can be sent from Feishu or WeChat.

item.title: Tencent Launches Buddy One, Linking Its Office Apps on One WorkBuddy Agent, and Tencent Drive
item.description: Tencent launched Buddy One, linking Tencent Docs, Tencent Meeting, ima and a new cloud drive to one WorkBuddy agent with shared accounts and credits. Tencent Drive links to agents via CLI and MCP.

item.title: DiffuSpace Open-Sources Clover-35B-A3B, a Diffusion Language Model Built for Agents and Coding
item.description: DiffuSpace has open-sourced Clover-35B-A3B-Preview, a 35B-parameter MoE diffusion language model. The team reports 73.6 on SWE-bench Verified and 515 tokens/s on one H200 in agent tasks.

item.title: First Ascend 950DT 1,024-NPU SuperPoD Cluster Goes Live in Wuhan, Built in One Month
item.description: A 1,024-NPU Ascend 950DT liquid-cooled SuperPoD went live in Wuhan on October 28, offering 1 EFLOPS of FP8 compute and 256TB of unified memory. It took one month from start to power-on.
